text: I wanted to make another video today, but then I received this message from a subscriber and it freaking pissed me off. How many times do I have to say the same thing over and over again? Guys, self-respect is paramount, but some people just don't get it. So my girlfriend and I have been together for about a year. Recently, she has started going out more, which isn't an issue. However, the issue is the places and people she goes with. She has been going clubbing with a group of friends, whom two have cheated before, and their boyfriends. And she has admitted to me, they have told her she can cheat and they would keep it a secret. I've told her I don't really feel comfortable with the idea of it all, but her response was, if she wants to go, she will go, and that isn't my choice and is carrying on doing it. What should I do in this situation? I love her so much, but I can't help but stress and worry when she goes out and I don't want to lose her. But the way it makes me feel affects my daily life. And this thing, please keep this in that though. Even this thing sounds annoying. Who are you freaking hiding from? If you watch my videos, you know, if you send me a message, I might cover it on my channel. If you want anonymity, ask for a one-on-one consultation. Confidentiality policies apply there. So here was my answer. Understand, if you do not respect yourself, nobody will. Let alone your girlfriend. If you ask your girlfriend not to go out with friends who cheated before and who tell her it is fine to cheat and we will keep it a secret, and she basically tells you to shut up, that she will do whatever she wants, and that your opinion doesn't matter, and you still stay with her. You are basically screaming to the whole world that you have no self-respect, no self-love, and no principles. If you want to preserve any dignity that got left, the only right step here is to break up. That is it. Another point, stop being a drama queen. I love her so much, I don't want to lose her. What is there to love? What is there to lose? A girl who treats you like nothing, who does not care about your comfort, who treats you like a doormat? It is not that hard to find a girl like this. What is so unique about her? Get yourself together, break up, and start working on your confidence, your principles, your love for yourself, and most importantly, your self-respect. Start going on other dates, live a good life, and then maybe you will find a woman who is actually a great partner, who cares about you, and with whom you can build a healthy relationship. There were some more messages there, but they are not that important. Main message here, guys, self-respect is paramount. If you do not respect yourself, nobody will.
